edges.subject: CLN6
edges.object: variant late infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: Dysfunctionality of CLN6 causes variant late infantile NCL (vLINCL).

edges.subject: variant late infantile neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis
edges.quote: This disease group is classified by the deposition of similar autofluorescence storage material in lysosomes that is accompanied by seizures, blindness and premature mortality in later disease stages.
